title: Captain Derek's Dolphin Adventure

services.name: Daytime Dolphin Tour
services.desc: Experience…Bottle-nosed dolphins swimming in their natural habitat! During your cruise along Tybee’s Historic and beautiful coast, you will see the Cockspur Island Lighthouse, the Tybee Island Lighthouse and Fort Pulaski Adult - $27.95 (For ages 13+) Children - $17.95 (Ages 12 and under) Small Children - $5 (Ages 2 and under) 1 - 1.5hours

services.name: Sunset Dolphin Tour
services.desc: Enjoy a sunset cruise in a more relaxed atmosphere where coolers are welcome aboard. Experience bottle-nosed dolphins swimming in their natural habitat! People often bring their own dinners or drinks. Adult - $37.95 For ages 13+) Children - $22.95 (Ages 12 and under) Small Children - $5 (Ages 2 and under) 1 - 1.5hours
